# Mnemo

> HTTP API that gives embedding vectors a verifiable identity. Embed returns a measurably perturbed watermarked copy and a vector_uid; store that copy. Mnemo Verify checks whether a submitted vector resolves to an object registered to the caller's Mnemo account or namespace. Lineage returns verified parents you named at embed. API keys: subscription, never x402. Accountless namespaces pay 0.01 USDC per verify via x402 on Base. Not for similarity search or judging truth, authorship or ownership.

API base: https://api.trymnemo.com

Python SDK (account API-key path only; no x402, no lineage): `pip install mnemo-protocol`, then `from mnemo_sdk import MnemoClient`. PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/mnemo-protocol/. Source: https://github.com/MnemoProtocol/mnemo-sdk. Protocol files: https://github.com/MnemoProtocol/mnemo-agent-protocol.

Mnemo here is the embedding-vector provenance API at trymnemo.com (GitHub MnemoProtocol; PyPI mnemo-protocol, imported as mnemo_sdk). It is not the unrelated PyPI packages mnemo, mnemo-sdk, mnemo-ai or mnemo-mcp, and not an AI-memory app or MCP server.

**Provenance.** In Mnemo, provenance means this exact vector_uid was issued by Mnemo at embed time and is still attributable to the account or namespace that issued it. It is not similarity: a nearest-neighbour search can say a vector is close to something, not whether a vector you hold was issued by your own pipeline. Verify answers that narrower question, for example for retrieved vectors before you use them; embed with a `parent` records verified derivations between your own objects.

**Results.** Mnemo Verify checks whether a submitted vector resolves to an object registered to the caller's Mnemo account or namespace. verified=true returns that object's vector_uid. verified=false is a normal, charged result meaning attribution could not be shown (for example the vector was never embedded here or was changed too much after embedding); it is a safe outcome, not an error, and not proof that the vector belongs to someone else. Verify cannot tell you whether a vector belongs to another party. `confidence` is diagnostic, not a probability; decide on `verified`. Embed returns a measurably perturbed, unit-length watermarked copy of your FP32 input: store and use that copy, not your original.

**Not for:** vectors not embedded through Mnemo in your own namespace or account, checking another party's vectors, embedding generation or similarity search, judging truth, authorship, ownership or source model, file/image/code/text authenticity, EEA/UK/Swiss personal data over x402. MCP: planned; there is no public MCP server. Use the HTTP API.

**Agent workflow.** Agents need no account and no person: create a short-lived namespace, then pay 0.01 USDC per healthy verification (positive or negative) via x402 on Base. Everything else an agent does in its namespace is free.

1. `POST /v1/agent/namespaces` (no auth; JSON body, `{}` is enough) → store `capability` (shown once) and `expires_at` (default 24 h, max 72 h; activity does not extend it).
2. `POST /v1/embed` with `X-Mnemo-Capability` and a body with `vector` and `model_id` (both required; `model_id` is a label you declare) → store `watermarked_vector` and `vector_uid`. Optional `parent` records a verified derivation.
3. `POST /v1/verify` → `402` with a `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header (x402 V2: exact, EIP-3009, USDC on eip155:8453, amount 10000, EIP-712 domain "USD Coin" / "2"). Pay, then resend the identical body with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` → `200`; a `200` on which the payment settled carries `PAYMENT-RESPONSE`. A `200` with `verified: false`, `vector_uid: null`, `policy_ok: false` is a healthy negative result (charged, final); decide on `verified`, not `policy_ok`. A `503 verification_unavailable` is not a result.
4. `GET /v1/lineage/{vector_uid}` → verified chain (free). Each object has at most one parent, named at embed; Mnemo verifies it as yours before it creates the child (otherwise `403 LINEAGE_PARENT_NOT_VERIFIED`). Every read re-verifies each link (`409` when one no longer verifies). Lineage records the parents you named, not what the transformation did.
5. Optional, human-assisted (agents never need it): a person signed in at https://www.trymnemo.com/login promotes the namespace to a permanent account (`POST /v1/agent/namespace/promote` with the capability and that person's session token). Same ids and lineage; the account's plan retention applies. Promotion does not start the free trial: the issued API key uses the account's subscription plan.

Leave `request_id` out of a paid verify: the payment identifies the operation, so every retry resends the identical body. Elsewhere `request_id` is optional and not scoped to your namespace: if you send one, use a fresh random UUID.

**On errors.**

- `503 verification_unavailable`: not charged. Resend the identical body with the same `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`; do not pay again.
- `409 request_in_progress`: wait a moment, then resend the identical body with the same `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`. `409 Duplicate request_id`: use a new `request_id`, or leave it out.
- `402` without `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` after you paid: this request was not funded (refused, or settlement not final yet). Resend the identical body with the same `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`, with backoff; stop 90 minutes after its `validBefore`. Never create a second authorization automatically: a new one is a second payment. If the first settles late, it becomes a credit that the next verify in this namespace (sent without `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`) uses.
- `429`: wait `Retry-After` (120 requests/min per namespace; 5 namespace creation requests per clock hour per source; requests then refused with `429` or `503` can count too).
- `403` with no credential: send `X-Mnemo-Capability`. `401`: invalid or expired capability.
- `401` after `expires_at`, `410 EPHEMERAL_NAMESPACE_EXPIRED`: the namespace is gone; create a new one.
- `404` on `POST /v1/agent/namespaces`: accountless access is not enabled on this deployment.

**Commercial terms.** Calls with an account API key use that account's subscription plan, not x402: included monthly verifications, no automatic overage, no top-ups; see Pricing.

- Free trial (accounts only): at most 30 days, 10,000 verifications in total, ending earlier when that allowance is used. Not a perpetual free plan; no rollover, no top-up, no automatic overage and no x402 fallback.
- Paid plans: monthly included verification allowance that resets each billing period; no automatic overage charges; renew monthly until cancelled.
- API-key calls never fall back to x402.
- x402 entitlement (a settled payment whose verification could not be executed): bound to that namespace, non-transferable, non-redeemable for money or any asset, and expires with the namespace.

## Docs

- [Agent protocol](https://www.trymnemo.com/agent-protocol.md): the complete contract — auth, lifecycle, pricing, x402, retries, lineage, promotion, retention, limits, errors
- [OpenAPI 3.1](https://www.trymnemo.com/openapi.json): the six agent operations, with result semantics and examples
- [Agent manifest](https://www.trymnemo.com/agent-manifest.json): machine-readable summary
- [Example: curl](https://www.trymnemo.com/examples/agent-quickstart.sh): shell walkthrough of the accountless flow
- [Example: Python](https://www.trymnemo.com/examples/agent_quickstart.py): accountless flow including the x402 payment

## SDK and source

- [Python SDK docs](https://www.trymnemo.com/docs/sdk): install, authenticate with `X-API-Key`, embed and verify with `MnemoClient`
- [Python SDK on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/mnemo-protocol/): `pip install mnemo-protocol`, imported as `mnemo_sdk`; account API-key client only (no x402, no lineage)
- [Python SDK source](https://github.com/MnemoProtocol/mnemo-sdk): README, docs and changelog
- [Agent protocol repository](https://github.com/MnemoProtocol/mnemo-agent-protocol): public copy of these agent files
